findings: This component previews pending changes, not completed operation results. It receives separately supplied pending/category lists and does not check their consistency or file freshness.

isApplyingChanges disables the bottom apply button, but reset-and-dismiss, per-item revert, and view toggle remain enabled. Whether caller guards concurrent mutations is still unreviewed; no runtime race is claimed.
AlertDialog confirm invokes onConfirm without rechecking isApplyingChanges or pending list. Pending data can change while dialog is open; the dialog body contains no frozen item snapshot.

Grid/compact row keys are unescaped joinToString of item IDs without category or destination prefix. Distinct rows with delimiter-containing IDs can collide; parent uniqueness and actual IDs need caller review. List mode uses action prefixes.
Group headings show destination display names with basename fallback, not full paths; equal folder names may be ambiguous. Preview includes no per-operation failure/result UI in this component.
Lists use lazy composition; grid rows are chunked and item restore buttons have 24dp visual size. Accessibility target behavior and screen layout were not rendered.
